title: Jesus Bids Us Shine
description: Jesus Bids Us Shine in Tonic Solfa to JESUS BIDS US SHINE: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the 3 verses, and a piano.
about: Susan Warner wrote the words; the Cyber Hymnal gives The Little Corporal (Chicago, 1868) as their source. Edwin Othello Excell wrote the tune in 1884.
underlay: Je-sus bids us shine with a clear, pure light, Like a lit-tle can-dle burn-ing in the night; In this world of dark-ness, we_ must_ shine, You in your small cor-ner, and I in mine.

lines: Jesus bids us shine with a clear, pure light,
Like a little candle burning in the night;
In this world of darkness, we must shine,
You in your small corner, and I in mine.
Jesus bids us shine, first of all for Him;
Well He sees and knows it if our light is dim;
He looks down from heaven, sees us shine,
You in your small corner, and I in mine.
Jesus bids us shine, then, for all around
Many kinds of darkness in this world abound:
Sin, and want, and sorrow—we must shine,
You in your small corner, and I in mine.
